title: [closes #215] Add JBang support
body:
Ensure you have local 0.0.4-SNAPSHOT build, then you can try to run it with 

```
jbang run -Dwanaku.version=0.0.4-SNAPSHOT wanaku@llowinge/wanaku/jbang-support start local
```
If you will be OK with this approach, i'll also add some basic readme how to run it.
author: llowinge

title: issue: Automate release with jreleaser and Maven #90
body:
Made following changes to the POM.xml file to resolve the issue

1.  JReleaser plugin is added in the parent "POM.xml" under the <pluginManagement> section.
2.  Added "jreleaser-maven-plugin.version" property is set corrected "pom.xml"
